notes: Heading: "8/2E-20R1 (8.0). About 2.5 miles southwest of Davis, 400 feet downstream from centerline of bridge on U. S. Highway 40, in Putah Creek channel on south side of low-water channel. Depth 33 feet." The "(8.0)" after the well number is not explained on this page and a small mark after "R1" cannot be read. Year is from the column heading "Date (1951)". Columns: altitude of ground water (given as water_level) and altitude of stream surface (given as elevation; "Dry" on many dates); "Difference" is computed. No owner or well name is printed: water_source is the creek whose channel the well is in and whose surface is measured. Remark on May 11: "Well completed this date." basin_or_area is from the running head (Water-level measurements - Putah Creek). No county or state on the page.
